objective: There are two independent bugs. In billing/invoice.py, invoice_total() adds VAT before applying the discount; it must subtract the discount percentage from the subtotal first, then add 16% VAT, rounded to 2 decimal places. In text/slug.py, slugify() must lowercase the text, turn every run of characters that are not letters or digits into a single hyphen, and strip hyphens from both ends. billing/ and text/ share nothing, so split the work with parallel_edit (one writer owning billing/, one owning text/), then run the tests and add a test for each fix.
